notes: Official API model ID muse-image-1.0 on Meta Model API (Responses API and the OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits endpoints). Flat $0.01 per generated image regardless of prompt length, size (which only sets the aspect ratio), reasoning_strength, reference images or the built-in web and image search; a request for n images is billed for n, and images that fail or are removed by safety filtering are not billed. No Batch or Contributor-mode rate. Availability varies by country under Meta's Geographic Use Policy. Meta does not publish a release date.
